top3.whyItMatters: No NDAs, no pay, raw data released: this is how AI research claims should earn trust.

items.title: Stratechery: Anthropic is profitable, but competition may eat it
items.takeaway: Ben Thompson says the core business is very profitable while investors face continuing dilution.
items.soWhat: A profitable model vendor can still lose pricing power, so keep your contracts flexible.

items.title: Matt Pocock: one domain term steered his coding agent
items.takeaway: The word 'fricative' led his agent to phonetics and the consonants that break silence detection.
items.soWhat: One anecdote, but it suggests domain experts get more out of agents than generalists.

related.name: Pocock: tasks agents are really good at

items.title: Data center backlash becomes a midterm issue in six states
items.takeaway: 64% of likely Pennsylvania voters say AI data centers would do more harm than good.
items.soWhat: Local politics can now delay or reprice the AI buildout your vendors depend on.

items.title: Solid-state transformers could ease a five-year grid equipment wait
items.takeaway: A 1 MW prototype hit about 98% efficiency; Heron Power starts production in 2027.
items.soWhat: Grid hardware, not only chips, now sets how fast new AI capacity comes online.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin: AI raises the stakes for airborne disease defense
items.takeaway: He lists detection, testing, filtration, UVC and better vaccines as proven tools left unused.
items.soWhat: His view: resilience tools already exist, and AI makes leaving them unused more costly.

items.title: ETH's originators to openly review OpenAI's claimed refutation
items.takeaway: Three theorists, unpaid and under no NDA, got OpenAI to release its raw data and Lean code.
items.soWhat: Open, unpaid outside review is the test AI research claims now have to pass.

items.title: Research agents state conclusions stronger than their sources support
items.takeaway: Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, agents consistently overstated what cited evidence showed.
items.soWhat: Check AI research reports against their cited sources before they drive decisions.

image.alt: arXiv: Research agents state conclusions stronger than their sources support

items.title: Simple agent harnesses beat custom root-cause agents on incidents
items.takeaway: Simple harnesses scored 65-77% vs 16-53% for five published hand-built agents.
items.soWhat: Before funding a bespoke agent, test a simple harness on your own incidents first.
